messages:
Lina_ACME: Hey team — after your rollout yesterday our summary endpoint started adding an extra paragraph about pricing in unrelated conversations. Not intended, customers are seeing: 

Lina_ACME: [example prompt] 

User: 'Summarize product feedback from thread'
Response: '...Summary... Also, note our promotional pricing: 20% off through May' 

This never happened before the 2026-11-02 rollout. Can you triage?

emma_cs: Thanks for reporting, Lina. Could you paste the raw request (prompt + any system messages) and the response JSON (anonymized)? Also which model + model_version and the request_id if you have it? :pray:

Lina_ACME: Model was redwood-alpha-3, request_id 01H4K9XYZ. Sending the prompt and response (sanitized):

Lina_ACME: ```
{"model":"redwood-alpha-3","system":"You are a concise summarizer.","input":"Summarize product feedback from thread"}

Response snippet:
{"text":"...Summary of feedback... Also, note our promotional pricing: 20% off through May"}
```

james_se: Thanks — that helps. Two quick asks: 1) can you confirm if any customer-side prompt templating added marketing copy (sometimes UI layer adds marketing tokens), and 2) if you can run the same request with model=redwood-alpha-2 (previous variant) and paste results?

Lina_ACME: Confirmed no extra templating on our side. Ran alpha-2 and got the expected summary with no pricing mention.

infra-bot: Deploy notice: rollout/redwood-alpha-3 v2026-11-02 promoted to production at 2026-11-02T04:12:03Z by ci-cd.

sara_repro: I'm going to try to repro locally. Can you also share the full response object and any headers (like x-rw-model-config or sampling_seed) — obfuscate any PII. If easier, upload to the presigned S3 link I just generated: s3.amazonaws.com/rw-tickets/abc123 (expires in 24h).

Lina_ACME: Uploaded logs to the link. Included headers: 
```
x-rw-model: redwood-alpha-3
x-rw-sampling: top_k=40, temp=0.7
client_version: acme-agent-2.5.1
```
Also included the full response JSON.

emma_cs: Great. @sara_repro do you need the exact rollout diff? I can pull the deployment manifest — there were changes to the system prompt and a new postprocessing filter stage in the runtime that landed in alpha-3.

sara_repro: Yes please. The postprocessing filter sounds suspect. If you can paste the config diff (or the small snippet) that would be helpful. Particularly anything that touches token-level rewrites or 'marketing' rules.

emma_cs: Diff excerpt: 
```
- postprocess: []
+ postprocess:
+  - name: marketing_phrase_strip
+    type: regex_rewrite
+    patterns:
+      - "(?i)\\b(promotional|discount|% off|sale)\\b"
```
(Note: this was intended to strip marketing phrases in some channels but may have been wired to the wrong route)

sara_repro: OK that lines up. I'll run the same input against alpha-3 with and without that postprocess stage and share a minimal repro. If it reproduces, we'll escalate to runtime to revert the rule on non-marketing routes.

james_se: If you can produce a minimal repro script, that helps customer and SRE to validate rollback. Something like: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-3","system":"You are a concise summarizer.","input":"Summarize product feedback"}'
```
And run it with the postprocess config toggled.

sara_repro: Reproduced locally with the postprocess rule enabled. With rule ON: response contains the extra pricing sentence. With rule OFF: no pricing sentence. Attaching two short diffs in the ticket.

emma_cs: Thanks — Lina, apologies for the regression. We'll open an internal incident to revert or scope the rule immediately and follow up. For our records can you confirm the customer-facing impact (how many requests, which customers) so we can prioritize? :folded_hands:

Lina_ACME: Impacted about 12% of summary calls over the last 24h for a subset of enterprise customers (we shared a CSV in the upload). Appreciate the quick help.

sara_repro: Filed rw-issue-1827 and linked the logs + repro. Assigned to eng-runtime with high priority. Next steps: rollback postprocess for non-marketing endpoints, run canary tests, deploy fix.

emma_cs: I'll keep this thread updated with status and notify once the rollback is live. 

Lina_ACME: Thanks everyone :heart:
